whatChanged.headline: Perplexity Wants AI “Teammates” to Keep Working. Who Checks Their Work?
whatChanged.headlineZh: Perplexity 推出不等指令的 AI“同事”，谁来检查它们的工作？
intro: Most AI chatbots wait for a question. Perplexity wants its new “Teammates” to keep track of a job after the conversation ends. Perplexity announced the feature in a blog dated 4 November 2026. It is now available on the web as a research preview for individual Max subscribers.
It is a small but important shift in the promise of AI: from answering a request to looking after an ongoing responsibility. The question is how much supervision that responsibility still needs.
introZh: 大多数 AI 聊天机器人等你提问，回答完就停下来。Perplexity 新推出的 Teammates 则希望像“同事”一样，接过一项长期任务，持续关注进展，不必每次都等你重新发指令。
Perplexity 于 2026 年 11 月 4 日在官方博客宣布这项功能，目前以研究预览版形式向个人 Max 订阅用户开放网页端使用。AI 从“回答问题”走向“负责工作”，听起来很方便，但谁来检查它有没有做对？

sections.heading: What does an AI teammate actually do?
paragraphs: Perplexity describes Teammates as agents that can plan a project, coordinate tasks and adjust their approach when priorities change. They draw on projects, tools, skills and memory already available in Perplexity Computer. A user can assign different jobs to different teammates and follow their progress in separate threads.

The company also says Teammates can work with one another and send messages through Slack. In its product description, an agent can monitor a task and respond to changes without waiting for a fresh prompt. These are vendor-described capabilities, not independent evidence that every job will be completed correctly.
paragraphsZh: Perplexity 介绍，Teammates 可以规划项目、协调任务，并在优先事项改变时调整做法。它会使用 Perplexity Computer 中已有的项目资料、工具、技能和记忆。用户可以把不同工作交给不同的 Teammate，再通过各自的对话线程查看进度。
公司还表示，这些 AI 可以相互协作，通过 Slack 与同事沟通，并在任务发生变化时主动采取下一步行动。这些是产品方描述的功能，不等于每项任务都已被独立证明可以准确完成。

sections.heading: Is this the same as a chatbot with a reminder?
sections.headingZh: 这不就是一个会提醒你的聊天机器人吗？
paragraphs: Not quite. A reminder tells someone that a task is due. A persistent agent aims to notice a relevant change, retrieve context, use permitted tools and take the next step. For example, a team might ask an agent to watch a project for missing information, prepare a summary and flag an item that needs a decision.

That makes permissions and review more important. An agent with access to files or work software may see sensitive information. If it sends the wrong message, changes a document incorrectly or misreads a signal, its activity could create work rather than save it. Perplexity says agents operate in isolated environments under existing tool and project permissions, and users can inspect or redirect their work. These safeguards still require testing in real workflows.
paragraphsZh: 区别在于，提醒工具只告诉你“该做了”，持续工作的 AI 智能体则尝试发现变化、读取上下文、使用获准的工具并推进任务。
例如，一家公司可以让 AI 关注项目资料是否缺失，整理最新情况，并把需要人决定的问题提出来。但能力越多，权限也越值得关注。它可能接触内部文件、工作软件和敏感信息。如果误读数据、发错消息或改错文档，省下的时间反而会变成返工。
Perplexity 表示，每个 Teammate 在独立环境运行，遵循既有项目和工具权限，用户可以检查、接管或调整工作。不过这些保护措施在真实工作场景中的效果，仍需要检验。

sections.heading: Who can try it, and what remains unknown?
sections.headingZh: 现在谁能用？还有什么不知道？
paragraphs: The web research preview is for individual Perplexity Max subscribers, not Enterprise plans by default. Perplexity says the feature is still in development and may change. The Verge reported a US$200 monthly subscription price, although annual billing can change the effective monthly cost. Perplexity says an iOS version is coming; its product page also mentions Android.

Public announcements do not establish a measured success rate for complex jobs or the amount of human review saved. Nor should “always-on” be read as a guarantee that every task runs continuously without interruption. Before handing an agent important work, teams need to test what triggers it, what it may change, how approvals work and whether its actions can be reversed.
paragraphsZh: 目前网页端仅向个人 Perplexity Max 订阅用户提供研究预览版，企业套餐默认不包含在内。官方提醒，功能仍在开发，表现可能变化。The Verge 报道 Max 月付价格为 200 美元；年付折算月费可能不同。官方表示 iOS 版本即将推出，产品页也提到 Android。
目前的公开资料也没有给出复杂任务的独立成功率，或能减少多少人工审核时间。“持续工作”不等于永远在线、绝不会中断。真正交出重要任务前，需要确认它在什么情况下启动、可以修改什么、何时必须申请批准，以及出错后能否撤回。

whatChanged.ending: The useful measure of an AI teammate may not be how long it works alone, but how reliably a person can understand, correct and trust what it has done.
whatChanged.endingZh: 衡量一个 AI“同事”是否有用，也许不是看它能独自工作多久，而是看人能不能清楚地检查、纠正并信任它完成的事。

stayCurious.headline: How Can a Fish Walk Around Singapore’s Mudflats?
stayCurious.headlineZh: 新加坡的泥滩上，为什么有鱼会“走路”？
intro: Look carefully at the muddy edges of a Singapore mangrove at low tide. A fish might be moving across the ground, propping itself up on its fins and watching the world with raised eyes.
It is a mudskipper. Despite spending time out of water, it is still a fish, with unusual adaptations for life between land and sea.
introZh: 退潮时走到新加坡红树林附近，仔细看泥滩，可能会发现一种奇怪的小动物：它用鱼鳍撑着身体，在泥地上蹦来蹦去，眼睛还高高凸起。
这不是长了腿的青蛙，而是一种真正的鱼，叫弹涂鱼。它怎么能离开水，还能在岸上活动？

sections.heading: How does a fish move without legs?
sections.headingZh: 没有腿，它怎么在地上移动？
paragraphs: Mudskippers have strong, fleshy pectoral fins that help support and propel their bodies over wet mud. Their movement looks more like a series of skips than walking with legs. The giant mudskipper, Periophthalmodon schlosseri, is the largest mudskipper species found in Singapore, according to NParks.

Its identifying marks include an iridescent blue-white sheen on the cheeks, a broad dark stripe along its side and a dorsal fin it can raise. These details matter because Singapore has more than one kind of mudskipper.
paragraphsZh: 弹涂鱼的胸鳍粗壮有力，可以撑起身体，推动它在湿泥上前进。它的动作更像一跳一跳地挪动，而不是真的像人一样迈步。
新加坡国家公园局介绍，大弹涂鱼（Giant Mudskipper，学名 Periophthalmodon schlosseri）是本地体型最大的弹涂鱼。它的脸颊有蓝白色的反光，身体侧面有一道宽宽的黑色条纹，背鳍还能竖起来。新加坡并不只有这一种弹涂鱼，所以不能把所有泥滩上蹦跳的鱼都当成大弹涂鱼。

sections.heading: How can it breathe outside the water?
sections.headingZh: 离开水以后，它怎么呼吸？
paragraphs: Fish usually rely on water passing over their gills. Giant mudskippers keep water in modified gill chambers while on land and can also take in oxygen through their moist skin. This is not the same as having human-style lungs. They remain closely tied to wet, tidal habitats and cannot simply live on dry pavement.

Mudflats and mangroves offer a changing landscape. Water covers the ground at high tide and recedes at low tide, leaving small pools, channels and exposed mud. For an animal adapted to both settings, that boundary is a place to find food rather than merely a barrier.
paragraphsZh: 一般鱼类靠水流经过鱼鳃获取氧气。大弹涂鱼的鳃腔经过特殊适应，能在上岸时保留海水，同时通过保持湿润的皮肤吸收氧气。这并不代表它长出了和人一样的肺，更不代表它可以长期待在干燥的地面。
红树林和泥滩每天都在随潮汐变化。涨潮时水漫过泥地，退潮后留下水坑、浅沟和露出的泥面。对弹涂鱼来说，水陆交界不是障碍，反而是它寻找食物的地方。

sections.heading: Why does one mudskipper threaten another?
sections.headingZh: 为什么弹涂鱼还会互相“吵架”？
paragraphs: NParks describes giant mudskippers as territorial hunters that feed on crustaceans and smaller fish. When another mudskipper comes too close, one may raise its dorsal fin and open its mouth to look larger. Herons and kingfishers, in turn, may prey on mudskippers.

These fish are also a reminder that an apparently empty mudflat is a busy habitat. NParks lists the giant mudskipper as threatened in Singapore, largely because suitable habitat is shrinking. Mangroves protect coastlines and support many other animals. According to NParks, less than 5% of Singapore's mangrove habitat from the 1800s remains, largely because of urbanisation and population growth.
paragraphsZh: 国家公园局指出，大弹涂鱼有很强的领地意识，会捕食甲壳类动物和较小的鱼。如果遇到竞争者，它可能竖起背鳍、张大嘴巴，让自己看起来更大。苍鹭和翠鸟则可能反过来捕食它。
看似空荡荡的泥滩，其实有一整套忙碌的生态关系。大弹涂鱼在新加坡被列为受威胁物种，主要原因是适合生存的栖息地不断减少。红树林不仅保护海岸，也是许多生物的家。国家公园局指出，受城市化和人口增长影响，新加坡如今保留的红树林面积不到 19 世纪原有面积的 5%。

stayCurious.ending: A mudflat may look empty at first glance. Wait a moment, and you might see a fish defending its tiny piece of land.
stayCurious.endingZh: 下次经过泥滩，别急着说那里什么都没有。仔细等一会儿，也许会看见一条鱼正在守护自己的小小领地。
